build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: The knight has a melee attack with a three-hit combo — pressing attack repeatedly chains strikes with increasing damage or range on the final hit. The combo is visually distinct per hit. Score 0 if no melee attack exists or only a single strike is available.

Sub-weapons (at least 3 types: throwing axe, boomerang, holy water, or similar) consume a shared ammo resource and provide ranged or area attacks distinct from the melee combo. Switching between sub-weapons is possible. Score 0 if no sub-weapons exist.

A village hub serves as the central area between stages, containing a shop NPC and a stage-select mechanism (gate, portal, or map). The player returns here after completing or failing a stage. Score 0 if no hub exists or stages are accessed only sequentially.

Each stage ends with a boss that has a visible health bar, telegraphed attack patterns, and a distinct defeat condition. The boss fight feels meaningfully different from regular enemy encounters. Score 0 if no boss encounters exist.

The shop sells health upgrades, sub-weapon ammo, and at least one other category (damage boost, armor, special item). Purchases cost gems collected from enemies and persist between stages. Score 0 if no shop exists.

At least 4 distinct themed stages are present (e.g., crypt, volcano, ice, swamp) each with unique tileset, enemy types, and platforming challenges. Stages feel visually and mechanically distinct. Score 0 if fewer than 3 stages exist or all share the same theme.

At least 5 distinct enemy types appear across stages with different behaviors (melee chargers, ranged shooters, flying enemies, shielded foes, spawners). Different enemies require different combat approaches. Score 0 if fewer than 3 enemy types exist.

Stages contain optional treasure chests hidden behind skill challenges (tricky jumps, hidden walls, timed sequences) that reward gems or unique items. At least some chests require deviating from the main path. Score 0 if no optional content exists.

Boss encounters (at least 3) each have unique attack patterns and require different strategies. Bosses telegraph attacks with visible wind-up animations and have multiple attack phases or patterns. Score 0 if bosses are identical or have no distinct patterns.

A victory or completion screen shows stats (stages cleared, gems collected, deaths, time) after completing available content. Progress is saved between sessions. Score 0 if no completion tracking exists.
A styled title screen shows the game name, the knight character, and Start/Continue options with thematic art. Score 0 if the game starts directly in gameplay or uses raw default UI.

The game flow connects title -> hub -> stage -> boss -> hub -> next stage without restarting. The shop, stage select, and gameplay are all reachable through in-game navigation. Score 0 if transitions are missing or require relaunch.
During gameplay, health bar, gem count, sub-weapon indicator with ammo count, and boss health bar (during boss fights) are visible in a clear HUD. Score 0 if no HUD is displayed.
Readability at 1280x720 is strong: the knight, enemies, platforms, hazards, collectibles, and background layers are all clearly distinguishable. Score 0 if elements blend together.

The art direction is coherent across title, hub, stages, bosses, and UI — a consistent retro action-platformer aesthetic with chunky pixel art and unified palette. Score 0 if mostly default UI or mismatched placeholders dominate. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

Stage environments use real sprite or tile art for platforms, backgrounds, enemies, and the knight — not plain ColorRect fills. Different stages have visually distinct tilesets and palettes. Score 0 if environments are uniform color fills.

HUD and UI chrome: health bar, gem counter, sub-weapon panel, shop interface, and boss health bar use styled themed widgets — not raw unstyled HTML 引擎 defaults. Score 0 if primary UI elements are obviously unstyled.

Animation and feedback: melee combo has distinct swing animations per hit, sub-weapons have projectile animations, enemies flash on hit, bosses have wind-up animations, and death/victory have transition effects. Score 0 if all actions snap silently.
